scripts.test:e2e: VITE_JAZZ_SERVER_URL=/jazz pnpm build && pnpm --filter @patchboard/web exec playwright test
scripts.verify: pnpm generate && pnpm --filter @patchboard/jazz-schema generate:private:check && git diff --exit-code -- packages/jazz-schema/jazz.generated.ts packages/jazz-schema/jazz.permissions.json && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:integration && pnpm check && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm --filter @patchboard/web exec node test/backend-write-proof.mjs && pnpm test:demo-proof

scripts.test:demo-proof: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @patchboard/server exec node test/demo-start-proof.mjs
